_note: Floor 1 of the Drambus Stack, and one sitting. `outside` is what makes it one: beating the boss puts you back in the field and a save taken inside reopens there too, so a floor is a thing you go in and finish or do not. Ten by ten, one thing at the end of it, and the next entry is a different map because the tower is a floor shorter. Which floor the door opens onto is derived from what has been answered rather than from a counter — the boss tiles are the record, and the order they come down in is the whole of the condition.

places.name: what is standing on floor 1
prose: The last of it does not come down. It goes, which is a different thing, and what is left is a ring of rind eleven inches high and a great deal of daylight where two hundred and ten feet of the Drambus Stack was.
The man from the tally shed writes the fifth line and then the sixth, and the sixth is the one that is not a drop. He has been waiting six years to have nothing to write.
There is a stump where the door was. Nothing is left standing.
